description: webhooks.getWebhook and webhooks.deleteWebhook (GET/DELETE /v1/webhooks/{id}) omit the 404 the live API returns for a missing webhook (probed 2026-08-13: status 404, code 'not_found', message 'Webhook not found.'), so distilled's typed union lacks NotFound on both operations. The Webhook provider's observe step (getWebhook -> missing -> recreate) and its idempotent delete both branch on the typed NotFound tag; without it the 404 surfaces as the out-of-union status class. Add the 404 responses so the generator attaches NotFound to both operations.
